cands.name: Kim Finer
cands.bio: Democrat, first-time candidate. Retired Kent State University professor of biological sciences (35-year career); Ph.D. in veterinary microbiology from Texas A&M. President of Friends of Delnor-Wiggins Pass State Park.
cands.local_ties: Born in Canton, Ohio; settled in Naples in 2012 (Sparker's Soapbox).

record.text: No prior elected office. Priorities: homeowner's insurance, school vouchers, local government control, coastal development, public health.

money_notes.text: Raised $25,982 from 146 outside donors plus $2,840 of her own money; no political committee money and no affiliated committee (Sparker's Soapbox).

endorsements.text: Democratic Environmental Caucus of Florida; 3.14 Action (per her website).

cands.name: Yvette Benarroch
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, first elected 2024. Born in San Juan, Puerto Rico; Air Force 1990-92 (Desert Storm era); co-owns a landscaping company and is a licensed Realtor; former vice chair of the Collier County Republican Party.
cands.local_ties: Moved to Florida in 2003; lives on Marco Island with her husband and two sons (Sparker's Soapbox).

record.text: First-term House member since 2024. Campaign priorities: stopping illegal immigration, Second Amendment, insurance, term limits.

money_notes.text: Campaign took in $165,230 including $58,000 from political committees; her own committee Friends of Yvette Benarroch has raised $155,401 (Sparker's Soapbox summary of state filings).

endorsements.text: Florida Chamber of Commerce (June 2026), Associated Industries of Florida (July 2026), Southwest Florida Young Republicans, and U.S. Sens. Marco Rubio and Rick Scott (per Sparker's Soapbox).

cands.gaps: No controversies verified. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.
